guide.heading: How to use FatahTech Invoice
guide.intro: Six steps from an empty form to a printed invoice or a whole batch of PDFs.

1.title: Fill in both parties
1.body: Start with Bill From and Bill To. Enter a name, address, email and phone, then use Add custom input for anything else that belongs on the page — a VAT number, a contact person, a project code. Save a party you invoice often and it is one click away next time.

2.title: Set the invoice details
2.body: Give the invoice a number, an issue date and a due date, then choose the currency. This step also holds your logo, a header and footer line, the purchase-order reference and your tax ID — leave the last two empty unless your customer needs them.

3.title: Add the line items
3.body: Each row is a description, a quantity, a unit price and an optional tax rate or discount. Drag the handle to reorder rows. Use the charges section for a discount, tax or shipping applied to the whole invoice; totals update as you type.

4.title: Customise the look
4.body: Open the template gallery to compare all fifteen layouts with your own data in them, then set the accent colour, the typeface and the density. On a desktop you can click any part of the preview to jump straight to the field that produced it.

5.title: Save it for later
5.body: Save keeps the invoice in this browser, so Load Invoice can bring it back later. Everything you type is also written to a draft as you go — the indicator at the top of the form shows when it was last stored, so closing the tab costs you nothing.

6.title: Print, export or go bulk
6.body: Print invoice opens your browser's print dialog — choose Save as PDF there to get a file. Export invoice produces JSON, CSV, XML, XLSX, DOCX or an EN 16931 e-invoice. For a batch, Bulk Export turns a CSV or Excel file into a ZIP of finished PDFs.

landing.h1: Free Browser Invoice Generator & Bulk PDF Maker
landing.intro: FatahTech Invoice is a free, browser-based invoice generator for freelancers, agencies and small businesses. Choose one of 15 professional templates, add your logo, colors and signature, then print or save a pixel-perfect PDF in seconds. Need a batch? Upload a CSV or Excel file and the bulk invoice generator turns every row into a finished PDF — no signup, no server, no data leaving your browser.

home.eyebrow: Free forever · No signup · Runs 100% in your browser

templates.heading: 15 Custom Invoice Templates — Customize Fonts, Colors, Logos & Signatures
templates.body: Every layout is a genuinely different A4 invoice, not one design recolored fifteen times. Sidebar layouts, bold headers, minimal receipts, ruled forms and centered mastheads are all included, and each one paginates properly when an invoice runs long.

1.title: Fifteen distinct layouts
1.body: Compare every template side by side with your own data in the live preview, then switch without re-entering a single field.

2.title: Fonts, colors and density
2.body: Pick from four typefaces, set any accent color or brand hex, and choose compact, comfortable or spacious density so twenty line items still fit on one page.

3.title: Logos and signatures
3.body: Upload your company logo and add a drawn, typed or uploaded signature. Your branding appears on every invoice you print or export.

bulk.heading: Bulk Invoice Generator: Convert CSV & Excel Data to Finished PDF Invoices
bulk.body: Bulk Export is built into the same browser app. Upload a spreadsheet of invoices, map its columns once, and download a ZIP containing every invoice as a finished PDF — ideal for recurring billing, month-end runs and agency retainers.

1.title: Upload CSV, XLS or XLSX
1.body: Drop in a .csv, .xls or .xlsx file, or start from the sample template. Rows are grouped by invoice number, so a single invoice can contain as many line items as it needs.

2.title: Map columns in seconds
2.body: Headers are matched automatically to sender, client, dates, line items, tax and totals. Check the required fields, adjust any mapping, and preview the source rows before exporting.

3.title: Download one ZIP
3.body: Apply a template, font, accent color and density once, preview a real A4 page, then export every invoice as a PDF in a single ZIP — entirely on your device.

privacy.heading: 100% Local & Encrypted: Your Financial Data Never Leaves Your Browser
privacy.body: There is no invoice database behind this tool. Drafts, saved invoices, clients and sender details live in your browser, encrypted with AES-GCM before they are written to disk — and the key never leaves your device.

1.title: Encrypted at rest
1.body: Saved drafts and records are encrypted with AES-GCM 256 using a non-extractable browser key, so casual inspection of local storage reveals nothing readable.

2.title: No account, no upload
2.body: No signup, no email and no tracking pixel in your invoice. The generator, the templates and bulk export all run client-side, so your client list is never sent to a server.

3.title: Export or erase anytime
3.body: Your data stays portable: export as JSON, CSV, XLSX, DOCX, XML or PDF, and delete saved invoices or site data whenever you choose.

landing.guideIntro: A walk through what the invoice generator does and how to use it: the fifteen templates, the things you can change about them, and the steps from an empty form to a printed invoice or a bulk ZIP export.

1.title: Fifteen templates
1.body: Genuinely different layouts, not one layout in fifteen colours — full-bleed headers, accent rails, centred mastheads, ruled forms and a compact receipt style. Every one is a proper A4 page and paginates correctly when the invoice runs long.

2.title: Make it yours
2.body: Pick an accent colour from the presets or any hex you like, choose between four typefaces, and set the density to fit twenty line items on one page or let three of them breathe. Add a logo and a drawn, typed or uploaded signature.

3.title: Print, PDF or bulk export
3.body: Print from the browser or use its Save as PDF option, with the invoice fonts embedded so every copy looks the same. For a batch, upload a CSV or Excel file, map the columns and download every invoice as a single ZIP — no server involved.

1.title: Fill in the details
1.body: Who is invoicing whom, the dates, the line items, and your payment details. Everything you type appears in the preview beside the form as you go, and your work is saved in your browser as a draft.

2.title: Choose how it looks
2.body: Open the template gallery to compare all fifteen layouts side by side with your own data in them, then set the colour, typeface and density.

3.title: Print or export
3.body: Print the invoice, save it from the print dialog, save it to reopen later — or use Bulk Export to turn a spreadsheet into a ZIP of finished PDFs.

landing.faqHeading: Frequently asked questions about the invoice generator

1.a: Yes. All 15 templates, unlimited invoices, PDF printing and bulk export are free, with no paid tier, no trial and no watermark. There is no account to create and no card to enter.

2.q: How does bulk CSV invoice generation work?
2.a: Open Bulk Export and upload a .csv, .xls or .xlsx file. The bulk invoice creator from Excel or CSV groups rows by invoice number, maps your columns to invoice fields, and lets you style the batch once. It then renders each invoice and downloads every PDF in a single ZIP — locally in your browser, with no server upload.

3.q: Are my client data and invoice records uploaded to a server?
3.a: No. Invoices, clients and drafts are stored in your browser and encrypted at rest with AES-GCM. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no server-side invoice database holding a copy of your financial data.

4.q: Can I export invoices as PDF, JSON, and XLSX?
4.a: Yes. Print or save any invoice as a PDF, and export structured data as JSON, CSV, XML, XLSX or DOCX, plus an EN 16931 e-invoice. Bulk Export produces a ZIP of finished PDFs from your spreadsheet.

5.q: Do I need to sign up or install anything?
5.a: No. FatahTech Invoice is a browser invoice maker: open the page, fill in the form and print. There is no signup, no download and no browser extension to install.

6.q: Can I add my company logo and signature?
6.a: Yes. Upload a logo on the invoice details step — it appears on fourteen of the fifteen templates — and add a drawn, typed or uploaded signature. Both are included in the printed PDF.

7.q: What currencies and languages are supported?
7.a: Over 170 currencies formatted for your locale, an interface translated into 18 languages, and invoice documents translated into 13. Dates and amounts follow the language you choose.

8.q: Can I edit an invoice after printing it?
8.a: Yes. The live preview stays editable, so change any field and print again. Saved invoices can be reopened from this browser, and bulk export always reads the spreadsheet you uploaded.
